entities.name: Sydri
entities.description: A young, brilliant human artificer of the High City of Paliano on Fiora, who animates objects and sells devices to anyone who pays.

entities.name: Paliano
entities.description: The High City on Fiora where Sydri works.

entities.name: Custodi
entities.description: A dangerous circle of elite priests who will do anything to gain the upper hand politically; Sydri has fallen in with them.

entities.name: Lord Zangari
entities.description: A client of Sydri whose death she may have inadvertently caused.

entities.name: King Brago
entities.description: A king whose treatment Sydri was possibly involved in.

events.summary: Sydri may have inadvertently caused the death of her client Lord Zangari.
events.quote: One of her clients was Lord Zangari

relations.quote: she's fallen into a dangerous circle of elite priests
Sydri is a skilled human artificer at the High City of Paliano on the plane of Fiora .
